mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of a near-term economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals a weakening economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 100 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% within a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market contraction, which increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX 5-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500, signals a broad weakening in consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 12mo_MA and HOUST < 1500 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, combined with a decline in GDP (GDPC1) from its prior quarter, signals a severe supply-side contraction, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 decline fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).
